name: Proxmox VE Detection Suite
summary: Tasks, high availability, cluster quorum, Ceph health and REST API changes on Proxmox VE, where Wazuh only decodes logins.
summary_zh: Proxmox VE 的任務、高可用、叢集 quorum、Ceph 健康狀態與 REST API 變更；Wazuh 內建只解碼登入。
notes: Wazuh ships decoders for pvedaemon, pveproxy and pvestatd and four rules, all about logins. Everything else a cluster writes (tasks, HA, corosync, backup results, the Ceph cluster log) arrived undecoded and matched nothing, or matched the generic rule 1002.

Tasks: a guest destroyed is level 8, a snapshot rollback level 6, a root shell on the node opened from the web interface level 5, a guest console, creation or migration level 3. A failed task is level 5; a backup job that ends with errors, or a guest whose backup failed, is level 10.

High availability and quorum: a node being fenced and this node losing quorum are level 12; an HA service in error or recovery is level 10; a node that drops out of the cluster is level 4, and level 8 when it happens six times in an hour. Corosync link flaps are recorded below the alert level and raise level 7 only in a burst, because a busy cluster network produces hundreds a month.

Ceph health from the cluster log on monitor nodes: a warning is level 7, an error or a down OSD or monitor level 10, a full OSD or pool or damaged placement groups level 12. The agent group drops the [DBG] lines (about 99 per cent of the log) and the regular HEALTH_OK.

REST API from the pveproxy access log: failed logins (level 5; six from one address in two minutes, level 10), and changes that succeeded: users, permissions and realms (level 8), API tokens (level 10), guest deletion (level 8), firewall changes (level 6), uploads to storage (level 5), cluster configuration (level 6). The agent group sends these lines under the program name jt-pveproxy so that the pack's decoder reads them: pveproxy logs an IPv4 client as ::ffff:a.b.c.d, the built-in decoders keep that prefix, and Wazuh's firewall-drop then writes an ip6tables rule that the client's IPv4 traffic never meets. The pack's decoder reports the plain IPv4 address.

Monitoring systems that log in every few seconds made the built-in rule 87203 produce tens of thousands of level 3 alerts a day (measured: 20,900 a day from one account). List such accounts in etc/lists/jt-pve-service-accounts and their successful logins drop to level 0. The key is the user name without its realm, as Wazuh decodes it. Failed logins of those accounts still alert.
Proxmox Backup Server has a pack of its own, jt-pbs.
notes_zh: Wazuh 內建 pvedaemon、pveproxy、pvestatd 的解碼器與四條規則，全都只管登入。叢集寫出的其他內容（任務、HA、corosync、備份結果、Ceph 叢集記錄）送進來後沒有解碼、也不命中任何規則，或只命中通用的 1002。
任務：刪除 guest 為 level 8，回復快照 level 6，從網頁介面開啟節點本身的 root shell 為 level 5，開啟 guest 主控台、建立或遷移 guest 為 level 3。任務失敗為 level 5；備份工作以錯誤結束，或某台 guest 備份失敗，為 level 10。
高可用與 quorum：節點被 fence、本節點失去 quorum 為 level 12；HA 服務進入 error 或 recovery 為 level 10；節點脫離叢集為 level 4，一小時內發生六次則為 level 8。corosync 連線閃斷記錄在告警等級之下，只有短時間大量發生才升為 level 7，因為繁忙的叢集網路一個月就有數百次。
Ceph 健康狀態取自 monitor 節點的叢集記錄：警告為 level 7，錯誤或 OSD、monitor 停擺為 level 10，OSD 或 pool 滿了、placement group 損壞為 level 12。agent 群組會丟掉 [DBG] 行（約占記錄 99%）與例行的 HEALTH_OK。

pveproxy 存取記錄裡的 REST API：登入失敗（level 5；同一位址兩分鐘內六次為 level 10），以及成功的變更：使用者、權限與 realm（level 8）、API token（level 10）、刪除 guest（level 8）、防火牆變更（level 6）、上傳到儲存區（level 5）、叢集設定（level 6）。agent 群組以程式名稱 jt-pveproxy 送出這些記錄，讓套件自己的解碼器讀取：pveproxy 把 IPv4 用戶端記成 ::ffff:a.b.c.d，內建解碼器保留這個前綴，Wazuh 的 firewall-drop 就會寫成 ip6tables 規則，用戶端的 IPv4 流量永遠碰不到。套件的解碼器回報的是單純的 IPv4 位址。
每隔幾秒就登入一次的監控系統，會讓內建規則 87203 每天產生數萬筆 level 3 告警（實測：單一帳號每天 20,900 筆）。把這類帳號加入 etc/lists/jt-pve-service-accounts，它們的成功登入就降為 level 0。鍵值是不含 realm 的使用者名稱，與 Wazuh 解碼的一樣。這些帳號的登入失敗仍會告警。
Proxmox Backup Server 另有自己的套件 jt-pbs。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: proxmox
agent_group.description: The Proxmox logs outside syslog: REST API changes from the pveproxy access log, and the Ceph cluster log on monitor nodes

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Assign the Proxmox nodes to the proxmox group
setup.title_zh: 把 Proxmox 節點加入 proxmox 群組
setup.body: The group collects the REST API access log and the Ceph cluster log, keeping only requests that change something, failed logins and Ceph warnings. The access log is sent under the program name jt-pveproxy (out_format in the group configuration); keep that line, or the API rules and the active response see nothing. Task, HA and corosync messages come from /var/log/syslog, which the agent reads already; on a node that logs only to journald, add a journald localfile to the agent's own configuration.
setup.body_zh: 群組會收集 REST API 存取記錄與 Ceph 叢集記錄，只保留會改變東西的請求與 Ceph 警告。任務、HA、corosync 訊息來自 /var/log/syslog，agent 本來就有在讀；若節點只寫 journald，請在該 agent 自己的設定加上 journald 的 localfile。 存取記錄以程式名稱 jt-pveproxy 送出（群組設定裡的 out_format），請保留這一行，否則 API 規則與主動回應都收不到。
setup.verify: Open a node shell from the web interface. Expect rule 131215 (level 5) on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 從網頁介面開啟節點 shell，manager 端應出現規則 131215（level 5）。

setup.title: List the accounts that log in for monitoring
setup.title_zh: 列出用於監控而頻繁登入的帳號
setup.body: One line per account, the user name without its realm, then reload the ruleset. Their successful logins stop alerting; their failures still do.
setup.body_zh: 每個帳號一行，使用者名稱不含 realm，加入後重新載入規則集。這些帳號的成功登入不再告警；失敗仍會告警。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the web interface
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入網頁介面失敗的位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address on the node that was attacked, for 10 minutes, after six failed logins from that address within two minutes (rule 131267, from the pveproxy access log). It uses iptables or nftables on the node, alongside the Proxmox firewall. It is not attached to the built-in brute-force rule 87202: that rule's address carries the ::ffff: prefix, which firewall-drop turns into an ip6tables rule that IPv4 traffic never meets. Needs the proxmox agent group. Risk: an administrator who mistypes a password repeatedly is locked out of that node for 10 minutes, and so is everyone behind the same NAT address, including a monitoring or backup system that logs in with a stale password. Put management networks in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址兩分鐘內登入失敗六次後（規則 131267，來自 pveproxy 存取記錄），在被攻擊的節點上封鎖該來源位址 10 分鐘。它在節點上使用 iptables 或 nftables，與 Proxmox 防火牆並存。沒有掛在內建的暴力破解規則 87202 上：那條規則的位址帶有 ::ffff: 前綴，firewall-drop 會寫成 IPv4 流量永遠碰不到的 ip6tables 規則。需要 proxmox agent 群組。風險：一再打錯密碼的管理者會被擋在該節點外 10 分鐘，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有使用者也一樣，包括用舊密碼登入的監控或備份系統。請先把管理網段加入 manager 的 white_list。
